problem_text:
A regional sales representative must personally visit seven distinct corporate branches to conduct quarterly reviews.

The travel durations between branches are recorded in minutes:
* Headquarters to Branch 1: 64.5 minutes
* Headquarters to Branch 2: 86.1 minutes
* Headquarters to Branch 3: 81.3 minutes
* Headquarters to Branch 4: 93.6 minutes
* Headquarters to Branch 5: 74.3 minutes
* Headquarters to Branch 6: 116.1 minutes
* Branch 1 to Branch 2: 70.3 minutes
* Branch 1 to Branch 3: 34.7 minutes
* Branch 1 to Branch 4: 135.1 minutes
* Branch 1 to Branch 5: 103.4 minutes
* Branch 1 to Branch 6: 91.6 minutes
* Branch 2 to Branch 3: 42.4 minutes
* Branch 2 to Branch 4: 179.0 minutes
* Branch 2 to Branch 5: 154.7 minutes
* Branch 2 to Branch 6: 161.7 minutes
* Branch 3 to Branch 4: 164.6 minutes
* Branch 3 to Branch 5: 134.9 minutes
* Branch 3 to Branch 6: 124.7 minutes
* Branch 4 to Branch 5: 34.9 minutes
* Branch 4 to Branch 6: 113.1 minutes
* Branch 5 to Branch 6: 81.4 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient itinerary that allows the representative to arrive at each branch precisely one time, concluding the circuit back at the starting location.
